svg.text: The escapement: an escape wheel and the anchor that lets it go one tooth at a time

g.text: The pendulum rocks the anchor. Each swing lets one tooth slip past one pallet, and each pallet gives the pendulum
a small push as the tooth leaves it. Drawn assembled; the shape itself is emitted with the anchor lifted clear of
the wheel, and the readout gives the centre distance to lay out the arbors at.
